title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment in space

tellings.quote: Uh but he tried to do it while he was in orbit. It was the first ever like psychic experiment in space.

plain: On the Apollo 14 moon mission in 1971, the astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run a test of ESP, meaning extrasensory perception, the claimed ability to send or receive information by mind alone, while he was in orbit. An online researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala tells it without naming a source, calling it "the first ever like psychic experiment in space," and links it to the card-guessing tests of the parapsychology researcher J.B. Rhine. It is told as a sign that serious people took psychic abilities seriously at the height of the space programme.
